name: PPSI
old_description: Our AS9100D-certified facility, IPC-610 trained technicians, and four decades of manufacturing expertise mean your products are built to spec and shipped on time, so you can focus on what's next.
about:
PPSI has been assembling electronics in Houston, Texas, since 1986. The company remains privately held and headquartered in Houston, where it grew from a small PCB assembly shop into an AS9100D-certified manufacturing partner.

Today PPSI provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing services under one roof: surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly with placement down to 01005 packages, custom cable and harness assemblies built to IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards, comprehensive testing including AOI, X-ray, flying probe, functional test and device programming, full box-build and electromechanical integration with conformal coating for harsh environments, and turnkey supply-chain management. The facility supports programs from new-product introduction through recurring production volumes, staffed by IPC-610-trained technicians operating within an AS9100D quality system.

The company serves military and aerospace, space and satellite, industrial, and energy and oil-and-gas customers. Its assemblies fly on defense and aerospace platforms, operate in downhole and pipeline equipment, and control complex industrial systems. PPSI’s high-reliability documentation control and process rigor are tailored for flight hardware and ground-support electronics that must not fail.

PPSI emphasizes stability from four decades in business, direct communication with the people building the product, flexibility in a high-mix environment, and the convenience of a Houston-based, U.S. manufacturing location that supports site visits and audits. The founding principle — build it right, deliver on time — still guides every order.
